policy: Donor files were read at their pinned commit in the local mirror (tools/mirrors.py), as data; nothing was run. Ideas only, in westack's own words; no donor text is copied (skills/westack/provenance/RIGHTS.md). The component classification is skills/westack/provenance/absorption.json (gstack.office-hours).

usefulness_legend.strong: shaped the skill's structure or its rules
usefulness_legend.useful: added a rule or a check

sources.read: lines 76-290 (context, modes, landscape, premise challenge, approaches)

taken.mechanism: Two modes chosen from the user's stated goal, with a switch from builder to demand when customers, revenue or a sponsor appear.
Six demand questions (demand, status quo, who exactly, narrowest wedge, surprise, future fit) routed by product stage, with an internal-project variant; five generative builder questions.
Asking one question at a time, pushing a vague answer, accepting a second refusal, naming failure patterns, brief acknowledgment of a specific answer, and a list of hedging phrases never to use.
A premise challenge with numbered premises the user marks; two or three approaches (smallest, best long-term, lateral) with effort, risk, pros, cons and reuse; a hard stop until the user chooses.
A design document per mode and one concrete next action; a private-by-default search of the space using general terms only.

rejected: YC branding, the personal plea, the founder resource links, the YC application nudge and the tiered relationship closing: content, not mechanism.
The builder and developer profiles, telemetry and the learnings log: westack uses the host's memory with an explicit save.
A second opinion from the codex CLI or a fresh subagent by default: westack-review's different-model reviewer, when installed and wanted.
Searching through the donor's own browser runtime: the host's search tool, on the user's yes.
